task_definition.task_description: Please check the current time in New York, then find an office room for 5 people on February 22nd, 2026, starting at 2:00 PM. After that, look up the lodging details for the Hilton Tokyo and get the gate board information for flight CA1234. Once you have that, archive the gate board details with the title "Hilton Tokyo" as a high priority email for user_889, and finally, create a backup of my trip planning workspace named NOTE18E3D.

user_input.query: Can you first check the current time for the America/New_York timezone? Then, I need you to find an office room for 5 people on February 22nd, 2026, starting at 14:00. Next, look up the lodging details for the Hilton Tokyo, and get the gate board information for flight CA1234. Once you have that gate board info, please archive it by sending an email with the title "Hilton Tokyo" to user_889. Make sure to set the priority to high. Finally, create a backup of my /workspaces/trip_planning workspace and name the backup NOTE18E3D.
